gap: No result ChatGPT got states that today the QIDI Q2 costs $449 on QIDI's US store, the same price ChatGPT showed for the Bambu P2S, and that for that money it has 65 °C active chamber heating and a 370 °C nozzle, while Hackster's reviewer found the P2S chamber is not actively heated and the cheapest active-heated pick ChatGPT showed was the $1,149 Prusa CORE One+ (55 °C chamber, 290 °C nozzle).
standout_why: goodprints3d.com (cited) names P2S, P1S, CORE One/One+, X1C, X1E, X2D and H2D but gives no prices, chamber temperatures or nozzle temperatures, and it says only that the CORE One+ has 'active temperature control'. 3dprinterlab.net (cited) gives specs for P1S, A1, MK4S, Ender-3 V3 Plus, Neptune 4 Pro and X2D (heated to 65 °C, no price) and names the QIDI Plus5 with no specs or price. Neither cited page has any price. speakcad.com (ranked first, not cited) lists a QIDI Q1 Pro at $449 heated to 60 °C and calls the CORE One chamber passive to about 55 °C, using launch prices it says moved during 2025. No result has the Q2, the Q2 price, the 370 °C nozzle or today's prices side by side.
decides: For the materials ChatGPT's own table lists for real parts (ABS/ASA, nylon, PA-CF), an actively heated chamber starts at $449 (QIDI Q2), not at the $1,149+ Prusa ChatGPT showed. At the P2S's price you get a heated chamber and a higher nozzle temperature. That makes the Q2 the value pick for engineering-filament parts. For PLA/PETG brackets and housings, ChatGPT's picks still stand. If the shopper needs a bigger bed, the Plus5 at $699 gives 320 × 320 × 300 mm with the same chamber and nozzle specs.

findings.label: Chamber heating (named reviewer)
findings.source_title: The Maker's Toolbox: Bambu Lab P2S 3D Printer Review – Hackster.io
findings.note: Cameron Coward (Hackster) says the P2S moves air with sensors and fans and that 'it isn't the same as active chamber heating'. The airflow handled ABS warping 'well enough', but the printer 'may still struggle with materials that need really high heat'. He measured the bed at 256 × 256 × 256 mm and gives $549 as the price at review time.
